4308.title: Hidden browser focus handling
4308.rootCauseOneLine: The focus listener forwards hidden uncontrolled views to the renderer, while the host-focus recovery predicate only recognizes automation-controlled views.
4308.proposedFix: Extend unsolicited-focus protection and deferred recovery to hidden entries after validating the native trigger.
4308.caveats: Unit-level handler failure repeated in two checkouts. Linux/Electron navigation-to-focus transfer and live typing remain unverified; no PR created.
